source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. System power should be off before test
2. Power on system and record the time when there is any video output
3. Power off system and remove all AC power cable
4. Plug all AC power cable to SUT
5. Power on system and record the time when there is any video output

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Video output should show within 5 seconds when power on

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: human at the machine + a display/monitor
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- Early video output: early video output timing needs a person to power-cycle the system (incl unplugging all AC cables) and visually observe the moment video appears within 5 seconds; the agent cannot toggle AC power or see the display output over SSH.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator powers on/AC-cycles and records whether video output appears within 5 seconds; agent cannot observe the display.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: AC power unplug/re-plug is a physical power action - human only.

original_test_intent: Measure whether the defined display produces its first visible video within five seconds of power-on both initially and after removal/reconnection of all AC cables.
original_method: A physically present operator uses a known-good display and synchronized timing reference, performs the two specified power sequences including manual AC removal/reconnect, and records first-visible-video time; logs only provide context.
manual_activity: The core criterion is a human-observed display event and the procedure requires physical all-AC removal/reconnection; the agent can only organize supporting timestamps and logs.
required_inputs: Definition of power-event t0 and first visible video
Approved power/physical AC procedure and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Physical AC removal/reconnect and power actions are operator-only under the approved SOP.
Do not substitute PDU/BMC/software cycling for the stated cable action or infer video from host/BMC reachability.
Use the same display path and timing reference in both runs.
Stop on ambiguous timing, display input, power state, boot failure or management loss; no automatic repeat.
agent_execution_scope: Collect SUT/BIOS/BMC identity and supporting POST/boot/health timestamps, align them to operator evidence and prepare per-run comparisons.
Do not claim to observe display output or issue the verdict.
engineer_actions: Perform both power sequences, physically handle all AC cables and record synchronized first-video evidence.
Confirm final safe state and issue the verdict for each run.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The narrative correctly rejects SSH as proof; no command can replace the specified visual event.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect only supporting BMC/console/POST timestamps; rely on synchronized operator video for the acceptance time.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The five-second limit, two power-on conditions and 15/15-minute values remain exactly scoped.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record the power event and display in one synchronized video/time base for each run, while separately preserving platform logs for correlation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems with the defined physical early-video output.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, display adapter/port and monitor identity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes t0, visible-event definition and evidence synchronization explicit.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Eliminates timing ambiguity and prevents boot-log proxies from replacing actual video.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Defined display path and timer method.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera/display latency must be understood; only the operator evidence proves the visible event.

project_override_considerations: A project may define the display port and capture method, but must retain the <=5-second criterion and separately report initial and post-AC results.
expected_evidence: Supporting boot/BMC health and final state

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criterion consistently require visible video timing under two explicit power conditions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operator procedure is concrete; visual/physical core acceptance makes the case MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps its correct manual classification and adds auditable timing semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its display-path, synchronized evidence and two-run safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves the exact physical AC requirement without claiming agent execution.

review_improvement: Defines the observable and time origin so five seconds is measured consistently instead of inferred from unrelated boot or management events.
independent_technical_reasoning: First visible video is an optical property of a specific output path; neither POST nor network timestamps prove it, and the source's physical AC condition must be performed and attested by a person.
